methods.chief_ray: native normalized unpolarized real ray, px=py=0; cross-check REAY
methods.pupil: uniform Cartesian grid in normalized entrance-pupil unit disk, six wavelengths; success requires ErrorCode=0 and vignetteCode=0
methods.radiometry: native relative illumination analysis; not inferred from pupil fraction
methods.focus: polychromatic axis FFT MTF at 20 lp/mm, f/5.6, 256 sampling; scan only, no official file changes
